minutes.headline: Commission accepted a donation from PJ Keating pending Selectmen ratification and approved a timber sale prospectus.
minutes.summary: The Conservation Commission accepted a donation offered from a PJ Keating environmental settlement, subject to ratification by the Selectmen. It heard several wetlands filings (a beach amendment, shoreline work, a tree house, a solar field continuation), approved prior minutes, and approved a timber sale prospectus and forest cutting plan amendment. It also discussed enforcement items and three prospective members.

what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission voted to accept a donation from a PJ Keating settlement, pending ratification by the Board of Selectmen.
The donation goes to the town administrator and Selectmen the following Tuesday, because a response is due by September 30th.
The Commission approved the timber sale prospectus and the forest cutting plan amendment.
It approved an amendment to an existing order of conditions for a beach at 667 Reservoir Road, and issued negative determinations for 238 Harbor Road and a tree house.
Requests at 48 Oak Ridge Road and 994 Northfield Road (a solar field) were continued to October 4th, and a 53 Pearl Street request was withdrawn.

why_it_matters: The donation gives the Commission money for conservation land without a direct draw on the tax bill, but it takes effect only if the Selectmen ratify it.
Ideas floated for its use, including an ATV for police patrols of conservation land, would be settled at a later meeting.
watch_next: Selectmen ratification of the donation, with a response due by September 30th.
The October 4th Commission meeting: project ideas for the donation, and the continued Oak Ridge Road and Northfield Road hearings.
